title: Missing values
hypothesis: Key nulls are quarantined, others are handled without losing rows; PR-AUC declines gradually with the null rate.

config.pipeline_phase: churn.prepare (profile -> clean -> features -> labels -> train -> select)
config.tuning: left enabled, as production has it; held constant across conditions
config.imputation_note: TRIAD does not impute during cleaning. Non-key nulls reach the feature tables and are handled by the imputer inside the model pipeline, so the measurable claim is that they do not cause rows to be quarantined.
